items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, that was Ridgely and Solestamp's tuxedo band.

ctx.x: All the young people used to go out there more or less, and there was dancing out there. There used to be a... I remember the old tuxedo band used to play out the tarantinas out there. Oh yeah? Tarantinas, yeah. Tarantinas, yeah. I think they had a band out there.
Yeah, that was Ridgely and Solestamp's tuxedo band.
And I'll tell you, they played out there too. They had a dance floor out there too. I mean, Bix, not Bix, Bias Dauphin. Yeah. Bias Dauphin used to play out there.
